title: ActMOF: Mapping Reticular Synthesis through Active Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reticular chemistry allows metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) to be designed from their building units, yet their synthesis remains constrained by sparse experimental data, noisy crystallization outcomes, and the absence of benchmarks for comparing active-learning strategies. While data-driven approaches such as Bayesian optimization (BO) can improve synthesis success rates, selecting appropriate optimizers beforehand for mapping MOF crystallization landscapes remains largely empirical. Here we present ActMOF, an experiment-grounded benchmark for comparing search strategies in aluminum-carboxylate MOF synthesis. ActMOF is emulated from experimentally measured microwave syntheses with each encoded condition assigned a crystallinity index calculated based on diffraction peak intensity and full width at half-maximum. translated_title: ActMOF：通过主动学习绘制网状化学合成图谱
translated_abstract: 网状化学使得金属有机框架（MOFs）能够从其构建单元出发进行设计，然而其合成仍受到实验数据稀疏、结晶结果含有噪声、以及缺乏用于比较主动学习策略的基准测试等因素的制约。尽管贝叶斯优化（BO）等数据驱动方法可以提高合成成功率，但如何事先选择合适的优化器来绘制MOF结晶景观在很大程度上仍然依赖经验。在本文中，我们提出了ActMOF，一个以实验为基础的基准测试平台，用于比较铝-羧酸MOF合成中的各类搜索策略。ActMOF基于实验测量的微波合成数据进行仿真建模，每个编码条件都被赋予一个基于衍射峰强度和半高全宽（FWHM）计算的结晶度指数。通过对由高斯过程（GP）、树集成模型和大语言模型（LLM）引导的策略进行基准测试，ActMOF……
tldr: 该论文提出了ActMOF——首个以实验数据为基础的铝-羧酸MOF合成主动学习基准，通过将实验测量的微波合成条件编码并赋予基于X射线衍射的结晶度指数，为比较高斯过程、树集成和大语言模型等搜索策略在绘制MOF结晶景观中的表现提供了标准化平台。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ActMOF, the first experiment-grounded benchmark for active learning in aluminum-carboxylate MOF synthesis, which encodes experimentally measured microwave synthesis conditions with diffraction-based crystallinity indices to enable standardized comparison of search strategies guided by Gaussian processes, tree ensembles, and large language models.
